# G02/G03 Checker, Behavior and fix requirements: Rust 5.0.6

Status: incomplete. The requirements below follow the locked producer's
checker/index.stg, behavior/index.stg and runtime module factories. They retain
the P1 integration requirements rather than treating emitted classes as parity.
The [current-lock helper replay and configuration review](checker_helper_dependency_closure_5_0_6.md)
adds 1318 live outcomes and reproduced a `uniStr()` clock-fix compilation gap.
The [string-clock repair](checker_clock_text_5_0_6.md) now compiles the generated
C++ model and matches 48 direct original/native observations. General clock-field
configuration acceptance remains open. The later
[configured clock review](checker_clock_configurations_5_0_6.md) repairs 14
additional binding failures, compiles 24 C++ configurations and compares 828
original entity/Checker field outcomes. Its complete-source errors remain explicit.
The [specialized boundary review](checker_clock_boundary_review_5_0_6.md) adds
thirteen compiler configurations and actual View/ValueObject selection evidence;
ten successful original bindings also compile in C++. The later
[composition matrix](checker_clock_composition_5_0_6.md) compares 1296 field
outcomes across 216 cases and repairs the template/strict-Boolean condition gap.
Original failed bindings
are retained rather than replaced by synthetic expectations.

| Requirement | Existing evidence | Remaining action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Typed logic, no-op implementation and Checker wrapper for every supported model | Twenty generated workspaces, positive/negative compiler controls, ordinary/optional and five inherited Checker matrices. | Finish the source branch and generated customization-surface review, including specialized models and source compilation-failure dispositions. |
| Required boolean/optional/text and Unicode scalar min/max helpers | Original generated School logic helper corpus; optional Reading custom logic and exact findings in three wire naming profiles. The new standalone closure verifies actual compiled observer bytes and replays all 274 helper/annotation results at the reference dependency lock. | Current-lock basic helper replay is met. Preserve its exact locations, operands, rule order and valid Unicode semantics in subsequent changes. |
| Generated Behavior defaults and custom overrides | Ordinary, inherited and constant module factories; existing SQLite extension probes exercise select/insert/update. The direct Behavior matrix observes all six hooks through actual generated registration. [Protected Behavior](protected_behavior_5_0_6.md) adds 1296 real SQLite deletion/recovery outcomes with policy, intent, version, event and trace boundaries. | Direct/default callback and protected deletion/recovery dispatch now have source evidence. Retain their distinct scopes while finishing the full customization-surface and integration review. |
| Registration and application-owned extensions | Four module modes and existing root/bootstrap comparisons. A handwritten business example now extends generated ProductCheckerLogic/ProductBehavior. | Qualify initialization order, replacement, real SQL use and Context cleanup; keep handwritten extensions outside regenerated files. |
| Predefined fixes, loaded-update checks, Business-ID immutability and custom callback order | Tenant/Note, optional fields, Business IDs, five inherited models, inherited custom governed saves and bootstrap extension matrices. Current reference dependencies retain the new 450-case composition and the unchanged 1044 ordinary Business-ID helper observations. The shared runtime and thin string-clock adapter repair the demonstrated uniStr compilation failure, with 48 exact direct outcomes and native evidence/lifecycle controls. | Ordinary configured scalar/JSON and inherited alias/required-JSON/FK/Context-root composition now have direct source results. Retain the explicit original failed bindings and finish the complete source/customization/integration review. |
| Trusted Context-root creation and update rules | Absent/matching/mismatched roots; zero and populated FK values; Create/Update/Unknown; inherited and bootstrap models. | Reconcile exact source root-error findings and evidence with successful governed-save configurations. |
| Create/update clocks and operation evidence | Shared-clock native/source fixtures, duplicate create-time evidence for updateTime, nested graph-fix scope, immutable policy-plan projections, and 24 scalar clock configurations with 828 exact original field outcomes. Timestamp-to-JSON conversion and non-convertible scalar storage remain distinct. | Retain source multiplicity, one operation clock and explicit custom clock behavior through committed, rollback and conflict paths. Review Business-ID/relation clock metadata, explicit required-JSON overrides, inherited/configured aliases and original optional Timestamp bindings. |
| Business-ID allocation/validation and evidence | Original profile/key/root/missing-service cases, SQLite recovery and accepted inherited binding adaptations. [450 inherited custom Checker/Policy saves](inherited_business_extensions_5_0_6.md) add committed, denied, trigger-failed and stale-version outcomes across all five models. | Inherited/custom Checker governed-save composition now has source evidence. Retain the original failed artifacts and exact binding adaptation; finish the remaining source/helper and customization review. |
| Protected execution and failure boundaries | Successful Tenant/Note save, trigger rollback, optimistic conflict, policy denial, constant/bootstrap governance, private runtime saver replays and real protected delete/recover SQL. Raw autocommit event failures retain 42 actual committed row changes. | Preserve the full runtime/provider/transaction obligations already tracked by G13/G15-G17; autocommit RequestPolicy/raw-event evidence does not replace whole-plan MutationPolicy, graph transaction or application audit delivery. |
| Ownership, API guidance and final gates | Managed logic borrows, Context callback quiescence, explicit output copies and actual User deletion in existing source/native/lifetime matrices. | Current native/module/sanitizer, Java and regenerated artifact gates plus accurate initialization/customization guidance are required before acceptance. |

configureRuntime installs default generated registrations. Application overrides
must be applied after that configuration, before ensure_schema or business work.
Calling configureRuntime/setup again replaces the registrations. This follows
the implemented assembly contract; the new example must execute that ordering.

General assembly/sample data/complete Assist remains G12. Indexed snapshot/cache
semantics are G15, privacy metadata is G14, durable dynamic storage is G16 and
canonical intent/trace is G17. These boundaries preserve the full goal scope.
